name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

# Cancel in-progress runs on the same branch when a new push arrives.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true

jobs:
  # ── 1. Format ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fmt:
    name: Format
    runs-on: firethorn
    steps:
      # rustfmt is a pure Rust binary — no C toolchain needed.

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@29eef336d9b2848a0b548edc03f92a220660cdb8  # stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt

      - name: cargo fmt --check
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

  # ── 2. Clippy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  clippy:
    name: Clippy
    runs-on: firethorn
    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config && break
            echo "apt-get attempt $i failed; retrying in 10 s..."
            sleep 10
          done

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@29eef336d9b2848a0b548edc03f92a220660cdb8  # stable
        with:
          components: clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@42dc69e1aa15d09112580998cf2ef0119e2e91ae  # v2
        with:
          shared-key: clippy

      - name: cargo clippy — deny all warnings
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

  # ── 3. Build ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: firethorn
    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config musl-tools && break
            echo "apt-get attempt $i failed; retrying in 10 s..."
            sleep 10
          done

      # The wasm32 + tract-onnx + musl target combination produces a lot
      # of build output. Free space up-front and at the end so subsequent
      # jobs on the same runner aren't squeezed by leftover artefacts.
      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          df -h
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/share/boost /usr/share/swift /usr/local/.ghcup \
            "${AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY:-/opt/hostedtoolcache}" 2>/dev/null || true
          sudo apt-get clean 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@29eef336d9b2848a0b548edc03f92a220660cdb8  # stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl,wasm32-unknown-unknown

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@42dc69e1aa15d09112580998cf2ef0119e2e91ae  # v2
        with:
          shared-key: build

      # Build the ingredient-ai WASM crate first so the larderly crate's
      # `scanner-wasm` feature can `include_bytes!` the resulting module.
      - name: Install wasm-pack
        run: |
          if ! command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            curl https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh -sSf | sh -s -- -f
          fi
          wasm-pack --version

      - name: Build ingredient-ai WASM module
        run: make wasm-pack

      - name: cargo build — workspace (warnings as errors)
        run: RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build --workspace

      - name: cargo build — larderly with scanner-wasm feature
        run: RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build -p larderly --features scanner-wasm

      - name: cargo build — musl static target (with scanner-wasm)
        run: RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -p larderly --features scanner-wasm

  # ── 4. Rust tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  rust-tests:
    name: Rust Tests
    runs-on: firethorn
    needs: [fmt, clippy]

    env:
      DATABASE_URL:          postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/larderly_github_${{ github.run_id }}_test
      SESSION_SECRET:        ci-test-session-secret-not-used-in-production-000000000000
      APP_BASE_URL:          http://localhost:3000
      S3_ENDPOINT:           ${{ vars.S3_ENDPOINT }}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID:      ${{ secrets.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:  ${{ secrets.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      S3_ASSETS_BUCKET:      ${{ vars.S3_ASSETS_BUCKET }}
      S3_UPLOADS_BUCKET:     ${{ vars.S3_UPLOADS_BUCKET }}
      S3_ASSETS_BASE_URL:    ${{ vars.S3_ASSETS_BASE_URL }}
      OIDC_MOCK:             "true"

    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config postgresql-client && break
            echo "apt-get attempt $i failed; retrying in 10 s..."
            sleep 10
          done

      - name: Create test database
        run: |
          ADMIN="postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/postgres"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_test;"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "CREATE DATABASE larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_test;"

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@29eef336d9b2848a0b548edc03f92a220660cdb8  # stable

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@42dc69e1aa15d09112580998cf2ef0119e2e91ae  # v2
        with:
          shared-key: rust-tests

      - name: Install sqlx-cli
        run: cargo install sqlx-cli --no-default-features --features rustls,postgres

      - name: Run migrations
        run: cargo sqlx migrate run

      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --workspace

      - name: Drop test database
        if: always()
        run: |
          ADMIN="postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/postgres"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_test;" || true

  # ── 5. Playwright e2e ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  e2e:
    name: Playwright E2E
    runs-on: firethorn
    needs: [rust-tests]

    env:
      DATABASE_URL:          postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/larderly_github_${{ github.run_id }}_e2e
      SESSION_SECRET:        ci-e2e-session-secret-not-used-in-production-000000000000
      APP_BASE_URL:          http://localhost:3001
      APP_PORT:              "3001"
      S3_ENDPOINT:           ${{ vars.S3_ENDPOINT }}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID:      ${{ secrets.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:  ${{ secrets.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      S3_ASSETS_BUCKET:      ${{ vars.S3_ASSETS_BUCKET }}
      S3_UPLOADS_BUCKET:     ${{ vars.S3_UPLOADS_BUCKET }}
      S3_ASSETS_BASE_URL:    ${{ vars.S3_ASSETS_BASE_URL }}
      OIDC_MOCK:             "true"
      # E2E runs ~80 tests sequentially from a single runner IP; the
      # default 30 mutations/min/ip would 429 mid-run. Effectively
      # disable the limit in CI — the limiter's behaviour itself is
      # covered by unit tests; the e2e job's job is the integration
      # glue. Per-test counts include retries (2x on failure) which
      # can push concurrent POSTs to surprising levels.
      RATE_LIMIT_MUTATIONS_PER_MIN: "100000"

    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config curl postgresql-client && break
            echo "apt-get attempt $i failed; retrying in 10 s..."
            sleep 10
          done

      - name: Create test database
        run: |
          ADMIN="postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/postgres"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_e2e;"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "CREATE DATABASE larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_e2e;"

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@29eef336d9b2848a0b548edc03f92a220660cdb8  # stable

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@42dc69e1aa15d09112580998cf2ef0119e2e91ae  # v2
        with:
          shared-key: e2e

      - name: Install sqlx-cli
        run: cargo install sqlx-cli --no-default-features --features rustls,postgres

      - name: Run migrations
        run: cargo sqlx migrate run

      # E2E tests mock the scanner module (the JS dynamic import 404s
      # gracefully and the page falls back to its stub). Building without
      # `--features scanner-wasm` saves a second wasm32 + tract-onnx
      # compile per CI run; the Build job already verifies the feature
      # builds cleanly.
      - name: Build app binary
        run: cargo build -p larderly

      - name: Start app
        run: |
          ./target/debug/larderly &
          echo $! > /tmp/larderly.pid
          echo -n "Waiting for app"
          until curl -sf http://localhost:3001/health > /dev/null 2>&1; do
            printf '.'
            sleep 1
          done
          echo " ready"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: tests-e2e/package-lock.json

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: cd tests-e2e && npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: cd tests-e2e && BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 npx playwright test

      - name: Stop app
        if: always()
        run: kill $(cat /tmp/larderly.pid) 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: tests-e2e/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Drop test database
        if: always()
        run: |
          ADMIN="postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/postgres"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_e2e;" || true

  # ── 6. Container build ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  container:
    name: Container Build
    runs-on: firethorn
    needs: [build, rust-tests]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.base_ref == 'main'

    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y docker.io && break
            echo "apt-get attempt $i failed; retrying in 10 s..."
            sleep 10
          done

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build scratch container
        run: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 docker build -f Containerfile -t larderly:ci .

      - name: Smoke test — binary exists in image
        run: |
          # Verify /larderly is present in the scratch image by extracting it.
          # Running the binary directly requires env vars (config loads at startup),
          # so we check existence instead.
          docker create --name larderly-smoke larderly:ci
          docker cp larderly-smoke:/larderly /tmp/larderly-smoke
          docker rm larderly-smoke
          test -f /tmp/larderly-smoke
          echo "Binary is present in the container image"

name: Pull Request

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

# Cancel in-progress runs on the same PR when a new push arrives so we
# don't pay for stale coverage / scan jobs.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  # ── 1. Test with coverage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Runs the full Rust test suite (unit + sqlx integration) against a real
  # PostgreSQL instance and collects LCOV coverage for SonarQube.
  test:
    name: Run Tests with Coverage
    runs-on: firethorn

    env:
      DATABASE_URL:          postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/larderly_github_${{ github.run_id }}_cov
      SESSION_SECRET:        ci-test-session-secret-minimum-32-chars-000000000000
      APP_BASE_URL:          http://localhost:3000
      S3_ENDPOINT:           ${{ vars.S3_ENDPOINT }}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID:      ${{ secrets.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:  ${{ secrets.S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      S3_ASSETS_BUCKET:      ${{ vars.S3_ASSETS_BUCKET }}
      S3_UPLOADS_BUCKET:     ${{ vars.S3_UPLOADS_BUCKET }}
      S3_ASSETS_BASE_URL:    ${{ vars.S3_ASSETS_BASE_URL }}
      OIDC_MOCK:             "true"

    steps:
      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/share/boost /usr/share/swift /usr/local/.ghcup \
            "${AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY:-/opt/hostedtoolcache}" 2>/dev/null || true
          sudo apt-get clean 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h

      - name: Install required packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config postgresql-client
          # Note: libssl-dev is intentionally omitted — this project uses rustls
          # everywhere and must not introduce openssl as a dependency.

      - name: Create test database
        run: |
          ADMIN="postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/postgres"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_cov;"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "CREATE DATABASE larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_cov;"

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Required for accurate SonarQube blame data

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          shared-key: coverage

      - name: Install sqlx-cli
        run: |
          cargo install sqlx-cli \
            --no-default-features \
            --features rustls,postgres

      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-llvm-cov

      - name: Run migrations
        run: cargo sqlx migrate run

      - name: Run all tests with coverage
        run: |
          cargo llvm-cov \
            --workspace \
            --lcov \
            --output-path coverage.lcov

      - name: Upload coverage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: coverage-lcov
          path: coverage.lcov
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Drop test database
        if: always()
        run: |
          ADMIN="postgres://${{ vars.DB_USER }}:${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}@${{ vars.DB_HOST }}:${{ vars.DB_PORT }}/postgres"
          psql "$ADMIN" -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS larderly_github_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_cov;" || true

  # ── 2. Security audit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Checks all dependency versions against the RustSec advisory database.
  # Fails on any known vulnerability in a direct or transitive dependency.
  security-audit:
    name: Security Audit
    runs-on: firethorn

    steps:
      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/share/boost "${AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY:-/opt/hostedtoolcache}" 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Install required packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install cargo-audit
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-audit

      - name: Run cargo audit
        # The runner pool's CARGO_HOME is on an NFS PVC (see
        # kubernetes/github-runner/readme.md). cargo-audit fetches the
        # RustSec advisory database via git, which uses flock on its
        # lock file — and NFS doesn't support locking. Override
        # CARGO_HOME just for this step so the advisory-db clone goes
        # to the pod's local fs instead.
        env:
          CARGO_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/cargo-audit-home
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME"
          cargo audit \
            --ignore RUSTSEC-2023-0071 \
            --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0002 \
            --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0098 \
            --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0099 \
            --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0104
          # RUSTSEC-2023-0071: rsa crate via sqlx-mysql (transitive, no fix available)
          # RUSTSEC-2026-0002: lru crate via dioxus/aws-sdk (transitive, no fix available)
          # RUSTSEC-2026-0098: rustls-webpki URI name constraints (transitive via reqwest/openidconnect; fix requires upstream semver bump)
          # RUSTSEC-2026-0099: rustls-webpki wildcard name constraints (same transitive path as above)
          # RUSTSEC-2026-0104: rustls-webpki CRL parsing panic — fixed in the 0.103.x line
          # via cargo update; the remaining 0.101.7 path comes from reqwest 0.11 (oauth2/
          # openidconnect) and rustls 0.21 (aws-smithy-http-client/hyper-rustls 0.24).
          # Both require major-version migrations of those crates to escape, so we ignore
          # it here using the same pattern as RUSTSEC-2026-0098/0099 above.

  # ── 3. Trivy security scan ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Runs two scans:
  #   a) Container image scan — checks the scratch image for OS/package CVEs.
  #      Because the image is FROM scratch with only a static musl binary,
  #      this should always be clean, but we verify it explicitly.
  #   b) Filesystem scan — checks the source tree and Cargo.lock for CVEs
  #      and misconfigurations (IaC, secrets, etc.).
  # Both fail on CRITICAL or HIGH severity findings.
  trivy-scan:
    name: Trivy Security Scan
    runs-on: firethorn

    steps:
      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/share/boost "${AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY:-/opt/hostedtoolcache}" 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Install required packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config musl-tools docker.io

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl

      - name: Build container image
        run: |
          DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 docker build \
            -t larderly:${{ github.sha }} \
            -f ./Containerfile \
            .

      - name: Trivy — container image scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: larderly:${{ github.sha }}
          format: table
          exit-code: '1'
          severity: CRITICAL,HIGH
          trivyignores: .trivyignore

      - name: Trivy — filesystem scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: fs
          scan-ref: .
          format: table
          exit-code: '1'
          severity: CRITICAL,HIGH
          trivyignores: .trivyignore

  # ── 4. SonarQube analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Uploads coverage from the test job and runs static analysis.
  # Requires SONAR_TOKEN to be set in repository secrets.
  sonarqube:
    name: SonarQube Analysis
    runs-on: firethorn
    needs: test

    steps:
      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc \
            /usr/local/share/boost "${AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY:-/opt/hostedtoolcache}" 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Install required packages
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y curl

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Shallow clones degrade SonarQube blame relevance

      - name: Download coverage artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: coverage-lcov

      - name: SonarQube analysis
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@v7.0.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_TOKEN:  ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
        with:
          args: >
            -Dsonar.projectKey=grimvoodoo_larderly
            -Dsonar.organization=grimvoodoo
            -Dsonar.projectName=Larderly
            -Dsonar.sources=crates
            -Dsonar.tests=crates
            -Dsonar.exclusions=**/tests/**,**/*_test.rs,**/test_*.rs,tests-e2e/**
            -Dsonar.coverage.exclusions=**/tests/**,**/*_test.rs,**/test_*.rs,**/main.rs,tests-e2e/**
            -Dsonar.test.inclusions=**/tests/**/*.rs,**/*_test.rs,**/test_*.rs
            -Dsonar.rust.lcov.reportPaths=coverage.lcov
            -Dsonar.scm.provider=git

name: Container Build and Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual triggering

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  create-tag:
    name: Create Semantic Version Tag
    runs-on: firethorn
    outputs:
      new_tag: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.new_tag }}
      changelog: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.changelog }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"

      - name: Bump version and push tag
        id: tag
        uses: mathieudutour/github-tag-action@v6.2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          default_bump: patch
          release_branches: main
          tag_prefix: v

  build-and-push:
    name: Build and Push Container
    runs-on: firethorn
    needs: create-tag
    if: needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag
    steps:
      # The musl + WASM build pulls in a lot of cargo deps during compile.
      # Free the ~30 GB of pre-loaded SDKs the GH-hosted image ships with so
      # buildx has room for the cargo target dir + intermediate layers.
      - name: Maximize Build Space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android
          sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost"
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=raw,value=${{ needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag }}

      - name: Build and push image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Containerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          annotations: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.annotations }}
          # Two-tier cache: GHA cache is fast for in-month rebuilds, registry
          # buildcache survives GHA cache eviction (10 GB / 7-day) so the
          # heavy cargo deps don't recompile from cold for every release.
          cache-from: |
            type=gha
            type=registry,ref=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:buildcache
          cache-to: |
            type=gha,mode=max
            type=registry,ref=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:buildcache,mode=max
          platforms: linux/amd64
          build-args: |
            BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1

  create-release:
    name: Create GitHub Release
    runs-on: firethorn
    needs: [create-tag, build-and-push]
    if: needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Create Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag }}
          name: Release ${{ needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag }}
          body: |
            ## 🚀 What's Changed
            ${{ needs.create-tag.outputs.changelog }}

            ## 📦 Container Image
            - `${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag }}`
            - `${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest`

            ## 🛠️ Usage
            ```bash
            docker pull ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest
            docker run -p 8080:8080 \
              --env-file .env \
              ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest
            ```

            See [.env.example](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/blob/${{ needs.create-tag.outputs.new_tag }}/.env.example) for the full list of required environment variables.
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
